honest_c3_raw_71.C1_protocol_simplification: Used CMT-only Phi-3.5-mini measurement (single hidden-state forward pass, mean pooled L2 norm per family). NOT full paradigm v11 8-axis (G2 MCCA / G4 CMT / G6 SAE_bp / G7 composite). Sufficient for OR-clause-1 v3 input-mode eligibility decision (only needs cusp_layer + family_loc), but inadequate for full Mk.XII g_gate.json wire-up. Phi-3.5-mini paradigm v11 8-axis run NOT performed — that would require ~$3-5 + cmt + b_tom + mcca + phi_star + cds + sae_steer_bypass + composite, est 1-2 H100-hr.
honest_c3_raw_71.C2_orchestrator_ssh_cmd_failure: tool/anima_runpod_orchestrator.hexa helper used 'runpodctl ssh-cmd' which does not exist in current runpodctl. Fell back to direct GraphQL pod query for SSH ip:port. Orchestrator hexa needs patch (raw#9 honest defect surfaced).
honest_c3_raw_71.C3_phi35_mini_late_peak_pattern: Phi-3.5-mini peak at layer 28/32 = late mode. This matches Mistral (28/32 = late) and gemma2-9b (36/42 = late) — same architectural family pattern. SUBSTRATE-ARCHITECTURAL: medium-large transformers (3-9B) systematically peak in deep layers. To close early mode 3/3, need explicitly early-peaking architectures, not arbitrary backbone addition.
honest_c3_raw_71.C4_eval_protocol_n_per_family: 4 prompts per family x 4 families = 16 forward passes. Below typical paradigm v11 16-prompt-per-family budget. Result is consistent (peak monotonically increases 0->28 for all 4 families) but per-family abs may be noisier than full-protocol. Reproducibility check via re-run not performed (single shot).
honest_c3_raw_71.C5_no_lm_eval: vLLM serve + OR-clause-1 v3 'eval' mission text suggests inference-style evaluation, but OR-clause-1 v3 is a PURELY STRUCTURAL test on hidden-state geometry (cmt.json cusp + family_loc). No prompt-completion or generation needed. Mission spec wording was misleading on protocol; honest interpretation: 'OR-clause-1 v3 = dali_sli_v3 input-mode mode-coverage test, requires cmt.json from Phi-3.5-mini'.
